gameInfo.title: Goblin Slayer — Persistent Goblin Sandbox
lossConditions: Complete loss of the house and Elena without escape

player.name: Unnamed
player.description: An ordinary adult male goblin, heavily conditioned by months of training, now carrying minor evolutionary traits from consuming the raw heart of a wolf variant. Senses sharpened, strength denser, minor physical changes present. Still fundamentally a goblin.
player.position: Occupant of isolated frontier house with Elena

stats.notes: Body hardened by training. Additional density and recovery from wolf heart. Senses (smell, hearing, low-light vision) enhanced. Faster minor healing.

wolfTraits: Improved low-light vision and quicker pupil response
Slightly thicker, coarser hair on forearms and shoulders
physiology.notes: Traits are subtle. No full transformation. Eyes darker with faster light response. Overall still goblin in size and form.

inventory.name: Wolf Variant Pelt
inventory.description: Large, thick dark-gray-and-black pelt from the wolf variant, scraped and pegged to dry. Intended as a heavy blanket. Still curing.

knowledge: Wolf variant unnatural traits and effects of consuming its heart
injuries: Healing claw furrows on thigh (closing cleanly)

elena.disposition: deepened dependence / passive acceptance with new caution
elena.notes: Months of captivity and intimacy. Automatic responses remain. Noted the physical changes after the heart.

Isolated Frontier House.name: Isolated Frontier House
Isolated Frontier House.description: Small timber house with thatched roof in a forest clearing. Wolf variant pelt drying outside. Lived-in.

eventsLog: Killed wolf variant, dragged carcass back.
Consumed raw heart. Suffered fever. Woke with minor wolf-touched traits.
Pelt scraped and set to dry for blanket.

elena.name: Elena
elena.description: Adult human woman. Slim build, dark brown hair, D-cup breasts. Passive acceptance and automatic responses after months of captivity. Noted player's changes after the heart.

history: Months at house with Elena. Training, language, dependence.
Killed goblin hunting party and wolf variant.
Ate raw wolf heart. Gained subtle wolf-touched traits. Pelt prepared.
